text:
hana: quick smoke request — customer Lucid sent lucid-lora-v3 and reports odd currency formatting and occasional dropped cents after we merged + quantized to int4. can someone run a short compat check against our hosted int4 profile? they included a 20-example mini-pack.

paul: taking. can you paste the 3 examples that first failed?

hana: sure — these came up in their QA: 
- Amount due: $3,499.99
- Factura: 3.499,99 
- Charge: A3500
They say outputs sometimes become "3500.0" or "3500" and cents disappear unpredictably.

ravi: kicked off eval on shadow-runner with rdx-base-3b quant=int4, adapter=lucid-lora-v3, samples=20. job id e-1769912345-a. ETA ~5m.

eval-bot: queued e-1769912345-a on runner-2. estimated runtime 4m.

paul: command used: 
```
redwood eval run --model rdx-base-3b --adapter lucid-lora-v3 --quant int4 --tasks currency-format --samples 20 --out /tmp/lucid-smoke.json
```

ravi: quick results: PPL(base)=11.2, PPL(merged)=11.9 (+6.3%). Numeric regressions: 3/20 had cents dropped, 2/20 token-boundary changes for thousands separator. One example showed tokens merging "3,499" -> ["3","","499"] after merge.

paul: interesting. did we try int8 to isolate quant impact?

eval-bot: re-queued e-1769912345-b for int8 run.

ravi: int8 run: PPL(merged,int8)=11.3 (delta +0.9%). Numeric regressions reduced to 1/20. So quantization amplifies an existing adapter bias.

hana: any signs adapter overfitting to rounded values?

paul: inspected adapter delta norms — a couple layers have high-magnitude rows (~1.8). Also checked training artifacts on customer ticket: Lucid says they augmented amounts by rounding to nearest 10 during finetune. that would explain bias.

ravi: local test: ran a clamp-merge where adapter deltas are clipped to [-0.6,0.6] before applying. int4 smoke with clamp: regressions fell to 0/20, PPL held at +1.2% vs base. script: 
```
# clamp merge snippet
python tools/merge_adapter.py --adapter lucid-lora-v3 --clip 0.6 --out merged-clamped.safetensors
```
I uploaded quick patch gist: https://gist.github.com/temp/lucid-clamp-merge

hana: nice. Action items: 1) ask Lucid for exact tokenizer recipe and any preprocessing (they already admitted rounding augment); 2) recommend retraining without aggressive rounding or with mixed-precision-aware augment; 3) add the 20 examples to onboarding-regress/lucid.json and tag label "currency-cents-drop"; 4) offer clamp-merge as a temporary mitigation.

paul: also worth testing a tokenizer remap that normalizes separators before tokenization (map "."->"," for euro style). did a quick remap run: token-boundary diffs dropped but cents-drop persisted. so two orthogonal issues.

ravi: filed short runbook draft for numeric regressions on adapter merges (triage steps: compare int8/int4, inspect adapter delta norms, clamp-merge test, tokenizer remap, add examples to regress suite). PR: https://git.redwood.internal/runbooks/pull/451

ops-bot: created ticket RW-55672 assigned to eng-ml: please attach Lucid training seeds when available.

hana: I'll ping SE to request their training recipe and augment config. cc @support-eng.

paul: marking thread as "smoke -> investigate". will follow up once customer provides seeds or accepts clamp workaround. thanks folks :thumbsup:
